mods.name: Chunk Animator
mods.description: A small client side mod that animates the appeareance of chunks so that they don't just instantly appear.

releases.notes:
This version includes support for Minecraft 1.16.4, 1.16.5, and OptiFine HD U G6. This will be the last pre-release before full release on CurseForge. 

## Changes
- Animation mode 0 doesn’t work properly on flat worlds, so it now defaults to 1. 

## OptiFine Compatibility Issues
This is currently not compatible with OptiFine’s `renderRegions` option, so if chunks aren’t being animated when using OptiFine make sure this is set to false in the `Performance` part of `Video Settings`.
